narrative.overview: Alice turns Git maintenance into a domestic sorting ritual. The interface is quiet and exact so the evidence remains readable; Alice's handwritten notes and local illustrations supply the personality. The complete idea/ prototype is the visual authority, not the discarded dashboard direction. Product truth overrides prototype theater: unsupported actions are disabled or absent, demo scenes are labeled, and no bin, undo, schedule, or patch-saving claim appears without an implementation.
keyCharacteristics: White-paper workspace with warm gray utility surfaces and thin rules.
Sweep, ask, and keep as the three semantic color families.
Inter for tasks, Kalam for Alice's voice, JetBrains Mono for Git identifiers.
Local raster illustrations for greeting, sweeping, and rest.
Standard desktop controls and a protected-focus confirmation dialog.

rules.name: The Verdict First Rule
rules.body: Red, orange, and blue are reserved for their respective verdicts and directly related evidence; do not spend them as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Handwriting belongs to Alice's short notes and group titles; it never replaces evidence, controls, or long-form explanation.

dos: Do keep the three-pile report and handwritten verdict notes at the center of the product.
Do use local raster artwork and bundled fonts so every scene renders offline.
Do label demonstration scenes and report real results without prototype-only promises.
Do preserve the readable list grammar at 1080×700 and allow vertical scrolling for overflow.
donts: Don't resurrect the discarded metric-card dashboard or laundry-fold motif.
Don't make ask or keep rows selectable until a safe workflow exists for them.
Don't invent bin, undo, scheduled-scan, patch-saving, or provider capabilities.
Don't use handwriting for controls, evidence, or long paragraphs.
